items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I saw him last summer. We had dinner together. And Freddy introduced me to Clark Terry

ctx.x: to his hotel and went down to see him at Alhambra Theater . He introduced me to Quincy Jones, and my boy that's just a wonderful trumpet player, today that takes it all. He was with Duke Ellington for a while --
